dex.text: Flat, grey and surprisingly tough, with a habit of splitting when you least expect it. Quietly proud of its roof.
dex.fact: Dinorwic quarry near Llanberis was once one of the largest slate quarries in the world, and it employed well over a thousand people.

dex.text: Stone-faced and iron-willed, it does not raise its voice. It does not need to, because the rockfall does that for it.
dex.fact: Slate splits into thin, flat sheets along its grain, which is why it has been used for roofs for centuries.
